d390_boost.about: The RenderThread's boost with compose-rs's own hint session (D390), computed from this run's traces: per run (scenario-app-run), the boost picture of HWUI's counter alone (hwui_min, as render_boost), of compose-rs's session's minimum (app_min), and of the higher of both sessions' active CPU votes (effective_votes: what the power HAL applies), plus CPU time and work by thread kind over the measured window (13 s scrolling, 9 s animating), for scroll, animation, stress_scroll and stress_animation.

prefetch_slices.about: Item composition and prefetch work on the main thread, computed from this run's scroll and stress_scroll traces (D430's item reuse on the device): per run (scenario-app-run), for each slice name (compose-rs's prefetch sections and frame phases; Compose's lazy prefetch and recomposition sections), the number of slices from the stats' start, their wall time, the main thread's running time inside them, its work (ms on the fastest core at its highest frequency, as work_ms) and its running time on the little cores. round_9_runs: the same, computed from round 9's traces (results/2026-10-23-pixel-8-pro-round-9.json), before D430.
